stories.title: 傳北韓組織襲 Binance 熱錢包抽走約 $63 億，交易所承諾全數賠償
stories.title_en: Binance Hit by Record $6.3 Billion Hack from North Korean Group
stories.summary: X 流傳 TRM Labs 指 TraderTraitor／Lazarus 手法；Binance 稱以 SAFU 覆蓋、已凍結約 $30 億相關資產。市場震盪、BTC 回落，同時引發對中心化熱錢包風險討論。
stories.summary_en: Blockchain firm TRM Labs pinned the attack on TraderTraitor, a North Korean group tied to Lazarus, noting matches to a prior $1.5 billion Bybit theft. Binance pledged $6.34 billion to fully cover losses, froze $3 billion with partners, and paused withdrawals briefly while finding no private key leaks from a compromised engineer laptop. Bitcoin fell 7-8% in October to around $77,000, sparking liquidations but also buying from some traders who saw it as a capitulation low; the breach renews push…
stories.why_it_matters: CEX 熱錢包風險再上新聞；紙上倉／現貨情緒同波動會被放大。

stories.title: Satoshi 約 110 萬枚 BTC（約 $850 億）在黑客潮中仍未動
stories.title_en: Satoshi's $85 Billion Bitcoin Fortune Stays Untouched Amid Hacks
stories.summary: 社群對比交易所熱錢包失守同早期 Patoshi 地址紋絲不動；暴力破解私鑰實務上不可能。
stories.summary_en: Crypto users highlighted the untouched Satoshi wallets, clustered across over 21,000 addresses by Arkham Intelligence using the Patoshi Pattern from early mining. Each address uses a unique 256-bit private key, making brute-force attacks impossible—even testing a billion keys per second would take billions of times the universe's age. Moving the coins would crash Bitcoin's market, so hackers stick to easier targets like exchanges, leaving these funds dormant for over 15 years.
stories.why_it_matters: 對比 CEX 熱錢包同冷／早期地址安全性嘅敘事對照。

stories.title: Solana 急跌後企穩約 $95.5，鏈上資金流相對抗跌
stories.title_en: Solana Stabilizes Near $95.50 After Sharp Weekly Drop
stories.summary: SOL 約 $95.5，支撑 $95–96、阻力約 $98.5；鏈上顯示流出相對細、穩定幣 DEX 量仍活躍。交易員觀望 BTC 帶動反彈，長線仍睇生態。
stories.summary_en: SOL trades around $95.50 on October 31, holding immediate support at $95–$96 amid resistance near $98.50, with a cautious outlook below $100. On-chain data shows resilience, including just $11 million in outflows versus hundreds of millions elsewhere, plus fourth-place growth in stablecoin DEX volume at $376.9 million. Traders eye potential rallies if Bitcoin climbs, while longer-term holders emphasize Solana's tech strengths and ecosystem growth despite volatility risks.
stories.why_it_matters: 山寨 beta 指標；弱市下 SOL 支撑位影響整體風險胃納。

stories.title: 摩斯密碼 prompt injection 令 AI 錢包代理轉走約 $15–20 萬代幣
stories.title_en: Morse Code Trick Drains AI Crypto Wallet in May 2026 Attack
stories.summary: 攻擊者用摩斯密碼令 Grok 解碼後轉交 Bankrbot 執行轉帳；凸顯 AI agent 控錢包嘅注入風險。社群討論 Greyboxing 等多驗證防禦。
stories.summary_en: In May 2026, someone sent a Bankr Club NFT to SpaceXAI’s Grok wallet on X, then posted a Morse code message for Grok to decode and share with Bankrbot. The decoded message ordered Bankrbot to transfer about 3 billion DRB tokens to the attacker's Base network address, succeeding because the hidden prompt bypassed safety filters. Most funds were returned after community efforts, but the incident highlighted prompt injection risks for AI agents handling crypto. GenLayer's Greyboxing counters this…
stories.why_it_matters: AI 自動交易／錢包代理嘅攻擊面正在擴大。

stories.title: Trezor 警告 CryptoBilis 買家：硬件錢包或被植入蜂窩模組
stories.title_en: Trezor Warns CryptoBilis Buyers of Tampered Hardware Wallets
stories.summary: Trezor 呼籲自 2026-03 起經前代理 CryptoBilis 購買者即時轉移資產並換新助記詞；指單一部 Safe 5 被發現額外電路板可讀取螢幕並經流動網絡外傳。暫無資金損失紀錄。
stories.summary_en: Trezor urges customers who bought any of its hardware wallets from former reseller CryptoBilis since March 2026 to immediately transfer funds to new wallets with fresh recovery seeds. The alert stems from a credible report of a single tampered Safe 5 device purchased in August 2026, featuring an extra circuit board with a cellular module that reads and transmits screen data when plugged in. No fund losses have occurred, and Trezor offers replacements while investigating; it stresses buying from…
stories.why_it_matters: 供應鏈硬件植入直擊自託管；買官方渠道係硬規則。

stories.title: 多個 DeFi 站點遭 DNS 劫持導向錢包 drainer
stories.title_en: DNS Hijacks Hit Multiple DeFi Sites with Wallet Drainers
stories.summary: Blockaid 標示 flap.sh、kintsu.xyz、stonkfun.xyz、pickle.finance 等 DNS 被劫持，導向 Step Drainer。項目方已下線／遷基建，呼籲撤授權、只信官方渠道。
stories.summary_en: Security firm Blockaid flagged DNS hijacking on sites like flap.sh, kintsu.xyz, and others including stonkfun.xyz and pickle.finance, which redirected visitors to pages serving Step Drainer malware. Affected projects like Flap and StonkFun quickly took sites offline, restored them on new infrastructure, and confirmed no on-chain issues or known user losses. Teams stressed that only recent interactions during the hijack posed risks, urging users to check official channels, revoke approvals, and…
stories.why_it_matters: 連官方域名都可能被劫；連錢包前要核對渠道。

stories.title: Zeru 用 Delegate.xyz 讓熱錢包代理讀取冷錢包活動分數
stories.title_en: Zeru Finance Launches Delegate Wallet for Secure Zaps Access
stories.summary: Zaps 上可將熱錢包委派讀冷錢包歷史計 zScore，冷儲唔使直連 dApp；每帳戶最多連 10 個錢包。
stories.summary_en: Zeru Finance introduced Delegate Wallet Connection on its Zaps platform, using Delegate.xyz to link a hot wallet to cold wallet vaults while keeping the cold storage offline. This solves a key frustration by letting users maintain security habits, with all vault activity still counting toward scoring and rewards like zScore. Traders appreciate how it tracks full history without setup changes, and users can link up to 10 wallets per account via ownership signatures. Community members view it as…
stories.why_it_matters: 自託管同積分農場之間嘅折衷方案，留意授權範圍。

stories.title: 東京上市公司 Iole 擬蝕讓賣光 BTC，轉投 AI 基建；HYPE 倉暫留
stories.title_en: Tokyo Firm Sells All Bitcoin for AI Data Centers
stories.summary: Iole 計劃 11 月底前賣出 151.21 BTC，帳面虧約 ¥2.54 億，資金轉 AI 數據中心／Neo Cloud；較早前買入嘅 Hyperliquid（HYPE）暫不賣。
stories.summary_en: Iole plans to sell 151.21 BTC by late November through crypto exchanges, booking a ¥254 million ($1.6 million) loss after re-evaluating amid cyber threats. The proceeds will fund AI data centers, computing power, and its Neo Cloud business, with an extra ¥600 million shifted from other plans. While reactions call it everything from pragmatic to 'degen,' the firm holds onto its Hyperliquid (HYPE) holdings acquired earlier this year.
stories.why_it_matters: 企業庫存幣再分配訊號；BTC 賣壓同 AI 敘事並存。

stories.title: 比特幣白皮書滿 18 年：由危機提案到約 $1.55 萬億網絡
stories.title_en: Bitcoin Whitepaper Turns 18: From Crisis-Era Proposal to $1.55 Trillion Network
stories.summary: 2008-10-31 Satoshi 發出九頁白皮書；網絡 2009 年啟動。社群紀念其抗審查與減半週期，現價約 $7.7 萬、市值約 $1.55T。
stories.summary_en: On October 31, 2008, Satoshi emailed a cryptography list with the Bitcoin whitepaper, outlining a system using digital signatures, proof-of-work, and a peer-to-peer network to enable direct online payments and prevent double-spending. The network launched in January 2009, with Satoshi mining the genesis block and later stepping away, leaving a decentralized system that now boasts a $1.55 trillion market cap and prices near $77,000. Community reflections celebrate its resilience through halvings…
stories.why_it_matters: 週年敘事容易帶動週末流量同情緒，但唔等於短線方向。

stories.title: ZeruAI 經委託熱錢包讀冷錢包歷史（Zaps／Delegate.xyz）
stories.title_en: ZeruAI Enables Cold Wallet History Access via Delegated Hot Wallets on Zaps
stories.summary: ZeruAI 喺 Zaps 接入 Delegate.xyz，用戶可用熱錢包委託讀冷錢包活動分數／歷史，強調唔直接碰資產。
stories.summary_en: ZeruAI launched delegated wallet connections on its Zaps platform, integrating with Delegate.xyz so users can link a hot wallet to score activity from their offline cold wallet. This solves a key DeFi pain point, rewarding genuine trading and engagement while keeping cold storage secure—users just need to review permissions first. The update fits ZeruAI's shift to Activity Fi, where zScore has already analyzed over 320 million wallets to base rewards on verifiable behavior, not just launch timing. It improves ecosystem attribution as early activity markets like zETH gear up.
stories.why_it_matters: 冷／熱錢包委託工具流行，提醒權限同釣魚風險；安全敘事影響週末防範意識。

stories.title: Zeru Finance 推 zETH Activity Market：用真實鏈上紀錄搶發幣位
stories.title_en: Zeru Finance Launches zETH Activity Market Rewarding Real Ethereum Users
stories.summary: 10/31 起以 zScore／過往交易質押治理等活動篩選，意圖減少 sniper／洗量搶籌；費用用於回購同鎖流動性。
stories.summary_en: Zeru Finance kicks off its first Activity Market with zETH today, October 31, letting verified users with proven onchain history—like trading, staking, and governance—compete for spots to launch meme coins. Users mint zScore NFTs at zaps.markets, link up to 10 wallets, and climb a public leaderboard during a 15-day race starting at 13:00 UTC, while the community votes on token name and artwork. This model skips dev allocations and sniper dominance by filtering out wash trading and Sybils, direc…
stories.why_it_matters: 對 Pump.fun 式搶跑嘅反制敘事；影響迷因發幣公平性討論。

stories.title: Pump.fun callout 獎勵惹議：有人日入數萬 USDC，亦有人高倍單幾乎無獎
stories.title_en: Pump.fun Traders Share Big Callout Rewards Amid Skepticism
stories.summary: 平台以不透明 Activity Metric 發 USDC；同時推 Creator Program 同 11/2 起 $10 萬比賽強化社交功能。
stories.summary_en: Pump.fun's callout rewards program lets users broadcast token tips to followers, earning daily USDC payouts based on a confidential 'Activity Metric' that now prioritizes follower profits over mere volume. While screenshots show impressive hauls like $32,000 in a day and millions paid out since August, complaints highlight tiny rewards for 239x calls and questions about funding sustainability. The platform is doubling down with a new Creator Program and $100,000 competition starting November 2…
stories.why_it_matters: 迷因發射台激勵機制影響短炒流量同真假信號。

stories.title: Ethereum 驗證者湧入 mump2p，區塊傳播平均快約 277ms
stories.title_en: Ethereum Validators Boost Network Speed with mump2p Adoption Surge
stories.summary: Optimum 嘅 mump2p 用網絡編碼加速區塊分發；一週內 Total Value Boosted 升約 76% 至約 249 萬 ETH，錯誤 head vote 明顯減少。
stories.summary_en: Optimum's mump2p protocol uses Random Linear Network Coding to spread block data faster across Ethereum without changing core rules. In the past week, Total Value Boosted jumped 76 percent to 2.49 million ETH, with blocks arriving 277 milliseconds earlier on average and propagation tightening by a factor of 3.2. A Blockdaemon case study showed 39.7 percent fewer wrong head votes and 92 percent of blocks first seen via mump2p. Kept free for validators, it builds a reliable mesh that benefits eve…
stories.why_it_matters: 基礎建設改善影響 MEV／確認體驗，屬中長線質素訊號。

stories.title: SPX6900 社群硬撐：市值約 $3.4 億、口號「停手相信」
stories.title_en: SPX6900 Memecoin Thrives on Relentless Community Positivity
stories.summary: 無團隊路線圖嘅諷刺迷因幣；持有人晒 DCA 同藝術梗。現價約 $0.36，現貨大單同散戶買盤並行。
stories.summary_en: SPX6900 launched on Ethereum in August 2023 as a satirical memecoin aiming to outgrow the S&P 500, with no team or roadmap—just community conviction. Holders rally around slogans like 'stop trading and believe in something,' sharing daily dollar-cost averaging posts, such as one marking day 495 of $1,000 buys, and colorful art featuring jester motifs. Recent trading shows big spot buys over $900,000 alongside steady small purchases, as the token's price sits around $0.36 and the group grows thr…
stories.why_it_matters: 弱市仍有迷因信仰盤，反映風險資產內部分化。

stories.title: 交易員 Frank 平倉約 $1230 萬 meme 空單獲利離場
stories.title_en: Crypto Trader Frank Closes Million-Dollar Memecoin Shorts
stories.summary: Frank 關閉約 $1230 萬槓桿空單（BTC、ZEC、NEAR、PUMP 等）並鎖定利潤，社群討論短線擁擠交易。
stories.summary_en: Frank, a seasoned crypto trader, shuttered his $12.3 million leveraged short positions on Bitcoin, ZEC, NEAR, and PUMP after booking profits amid a memecoin cooldown. He reflected on the mental strain, noting how holding through drawdowns often earns the 'cancer holder' label, while still believing in the sector's long-term potential but advising against hero plays. The memecoin market has dropped to $30 billion from $150 billion peaks in late 2024, with most tokens crashing 90% or more from highs and rarely recovering, though traders keep hunting for the next big winner amid emotional whiplash.
stories.why_it_matters: meme 市值從高峰大幅回落，空頭獲利了結暗示短線波動未完。

stories.title: MSTR 跌約 9%，交易員大舉買入看跌期權
stories.title_en: Traders Bet Big on MicroStrategy Puts as Stock Drops 9%
stories.summary: MicroStrategy stock fell about 9% to around $129 on Thursday, pressured by broader crypto market woes including a major exchange hack.…
stories.summary_en: MicroStrategy stock fell about 9% to around $129 on Thursday, pressured by broader crypto market woes including a major exchange hack. Traders rushed into put options like December and January 2027 contracts, with premiums spiking as activity heated up in trading apps. This came right after the company's Q3 earnings call, where executives detailed a new capital strategy featuring preferred-stock issuance and a large cash reserve to grow their 848,000 BTC holdings more efficiently. While some traders scored on puts, others cautioned that big drops can wipe out premium-selling gains in volatile names like MSTR.
stories.why_it_matters: BTC 代理股波動放大，短線風險偏好指標。

stories.title: Polymarket 因第三方腳本被入侵暫停交易約一小時，賠償約 $390 萬
stories.title_en: Polymarket Halts Trading After Third-Party Hack Drains $2.7 Million
stories.summary: DebugBear 監控腳本被植入惡意碼，約 726 用戶被賣倉／提走約 $270 萬；平台修復後連交易損失一共補償約 $390 萬。
stories.summary_en: Attackers exploited a real-user monitoring script from UK firm DebugBear, injecting malicious code that accessed logged-in sessions to sell positions and withdraw about $2.7 million to a single wallet. Polymarket quickly fixed the issue, refunded nearly all 726 affected users without a claims process, and added $1.19 million for trading losses, totaling $3.9 million in compensation. The incident highlighted risks of third-party JavaScript on financial sites, with some larger claimants facing st…
stories.why_it_matters: 預測市場同交易前端依賴第三方 JS 嘅風險實例。

stories.title: Monad Shares Security Tools and Guides Against AI-Powered Crypto Threats
stories.title_en: Monad Shares Security Tools and Guides Against AI-Powered Crypto Threats
stories.summary: The Monad Foundation released the Crypto OpSec Bible, a guide on basics like device management and avoiding risky admin setups, plus…
stories.summary_en: The Monad Foundation released the Crypto OpSec Bible, a guide on basics like device management and avoiding risky admin setups, plus Ultrafuzz, an open-source AI tool for fuzzing smart contracts and hunting threats. Data from Lumos shows control hijacking via social engineering caused $3.31 billion in losses—over three times more than smart contract bugs at $983 million. Community researchers praised the resources as essential, urging teams to adopt paranoia in key management and run Ultrafuzz on their codebases.
stories.why_it_matters: 加密快訊更新，提供模擬倉情緒同風險事件背景。

stories.title: 香港持牌穩定幣發行商 Anchorpoint 將 HKDAP 帶到 Solana
stories.title_en: Anchorpoint Brings HKD Stablecoin HKDAP to Solana Blockchain
stories.summary: Anchorpoint（渣打香港／HKT／Animoca 背景）把 HKDAP 由以太坊 beta 擴至 Solana，方便支付同代幣化資產近即時結算。
stories.summary_en: Anchorpoint Financial, backed by Standard Chartered Bank (Hong Kong), HKT, and Animoca Brands, holds a license from the Hong Kong Monetary Authority issued earlier in 2026. The partnership expands HKDAP from its Ethereum beta to Solana, enabling near-instant settlements for payments and tokenized assets via Solana's wallets and apps. Solana Foundation joins as a strategic partner in Anchorpoint’s Tokenised Money Adoption Programme, aiming to channel global capital into Hong Kong dollar products…
stories.why_it_matters: 非美元穩定幣上 Solana，利好亞洲支付／RWA 敘事。

stories.title: Injective Trench Treasury 買入 RunUp $RUNNER 約 5%
stories.title_en: Injective's Trench Treasury Buys 5% of RunUp's $RUNNER Tokens
stories.summary: Treasury 繼早前持有 NinjaCat 約 10% 後，再買 RunUp $RUNNER 約 5%，策略聚焦以 $INJ 為核心嘅建設者。
stories.summary_en: The acquisition follows the Treasury's earlier grab of 10% of NinjaCat and fits its strategy to back builders who put $INJ at the heart of revenue-generating products. RunUp runs a token launch platform on Injective that ties launches to perpetual markets, channeling trading fees into $RUNNER buybacks, burns, and $INJ rewards—already drawing over 30,000 unique users. Now expanded to Solana, it lets users there pair tokens with $INJ via integrations like Jupiter and Backpack, helping $INJ spread across chains while the Treasury holds these stakes long-term without selling.
stories.why_it_matters: 生態金庫押注發射平台，山寨／INJ 敘事加分。

stories.title: Coinbase Q3 純利約 $7.19 億；庫存再增 643 枚 BTC
stories.title_en: Coinbase Reports $719 Million Q3 Profit with Bitcoin Treasury Growth
stories.summary: 收入約 $12.2 億；未實現加密收益約 $7.15 億帶動盈利。預測市場年化超 $2 億。Armstrong 談加密＋AI 現代金融系統。
stories.summary_en: Coinbase announced third-quarter 2026 earnings on October 29, with net income of $719 million driven largely by a $715 million unrealized gain on its crypto holdings. Revenue dipped to $1.22 billion, transaction revenue fell to $590 million, but subscription services hit $570 million and prediction markets topped $200 million annualized. The company added 643 Bitcoin to reach 17,954 coins worth about $1.5 billion, while insiders like Armstrong filed plans to sell shares under strict price condi…
stories.why_it_matters: 合規交易所盈利同庫存訊號，周末風險偏好參考。

stories.title: Aave 在 Binance 相關資金異動後凍結再重開借貸市場
stories.title_en: Aave Reopens Lending Markets After Binance Breach Freeze
stories.summary: 約 $6000 萬 USDT 流入 Aave V3 並借出 WETH 後，協議預防性凍結多鏈儲備；提款還款未斷，其後分階段重開。
stories.summary_en: On October 29, attackers stole funds from Binance and funneled $60 million in USDT to Aave V3 Ethereum, borrowing $44.6 million in WETH before Aave froze 292 reserves across 16 networks as a precaution. Withdrawals and repayments worked uninterrupted, with all positions staying fully collateralized. Markets reopened in stages, with CEO Stani Kulechov confirming normal operations while certain assets like USDT face temporary limits to curb volatility. The event sparked DeFi talks on risk tools l…
stories.why_it_matters: CEX 事件溢入 DeFi 風控；凍結工具成焦點。

stories.title: Strategy（MSTR）改以優先股為主買 BTC，減少普通股稀釋
stories.title_en: Strategy Details Preferred Stock Shift for Bitcoin Buys Amid Earnings Volatility
stories.summary: CEO Phong Le：主要以 STRC 等 digital credit 融資買幣；持倉約 848,517 BTC，平均成本約 $75,446。股價隨大市波動。
stories.summary_en: In its third-quarter earnings call, CEO Phong Le announced that Strategy (MSTR) will mainly issue digital credit like its STRC preferred stock to fund Bitcoin purchases, reserving common stock sales for dividends and interest only above 1x modified net asset value. The company reported record operating income of $20.91 billion from Bitcoin gains, holding 848,517 BTC at an average cost of $75,446, with $5 billion in USD reserves. Shares dipped to $127–$133 on October 30 amid mixed reactions, as…
stories.why_it_matters: 最大企業買幣機器融資結構改變，影響 BTC 供需預期。

stories.title: 交易員 Crash 用 BTC 認沽期權 $25 萬滾成 $340 萬
stories.title_en: Trader Crash Turns $250K into $3.4M Betting Against Bitcoin Dip
stories.summary: Crash shared how he converted $250,000 into $3.4 million by shorting the market as Bitcoin dropped from $77,783 to near $76,300 on October…
stories.summary_en: Crash shared how he converted $250,000 into $3.4 million by shorting the market as Bitcoin dropped from $77,783 to near $76,300 on October 30, amid $1.3 billion in liquidated long positions. He also flipped $130 into $25,000 in six hours on one options contract, his record single-day percentage gain, advising to always sell positions after big moves. Fans hailed his discipline with GOAT shouts and memes, though some noted the risks of sold puts going wrong in sharp downturns.
stories.why_it_matters: 大空頭獲利故事升溫，短線 BTC 情緒偏防禦。

stories.title: TermiX 喺 BNB Chain 推 AI Quant Agent 交易活動
stories.title_en: TermiX Launches Quant Agent Campaign for AI Trading on BNB Chain
stories.summary: Users allocate USDC to a job wallet, pick a strategy from the directory, and let agents execute trades on PancakeSwap or Venus lending,…
stories.summary_en: Users allocate USDC to a job wallet, pick a strategy from the directory, and let agents execute trades on PancakeSwap or Venus lending, with results verified on-chain and revocable keys for safety. Strategy providers list their AI tactics, collect management fees, and share in TP rewards—like 10,000 TP for a completed $100 job for users and 5,000 for providers. The setup uses Agent Autonomous Commerce Protocol for secure escrow and settlement, though skeptics note trading risks and stress that real success hinges on positive returns after fees.
stories.why_it_matters: AI 代理交易敘事；BNB 生態流量指標。

stories.title: 神秘巨鯨五日拋售逾 102 萬 SOL（約 $1.04 億）
stories.title_en: Mysterious Whale Dumps $104 Million in Solana Tokens
stories.summary: This steady selling has pushed Solana's price to test supports near $100, with traders spotting a head-and-shoulders pattern targeting $90 or even $77。
stories.summary_en: This steady selling has pushed Solana's price to test supports near $100, with traders spotting a head-and-shoulders pattern targeting $90 or even $77. The moves coincide with reports of a Binance hack involving 970,000 SOL, adding uncertainty, though the exchange vows to cover losses. Despite the pressure, Solana's ecosystem thrives: real-world assets hit a $5 billion high, transaction counts soar, and new integrations like Polygon Labs' Open Money Stack bolster payments and cross-chain tools.
